test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (JSO) 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
For a data set with 24 observations given below, the median is:

10, 11, 13, 13, 18, 20, 22, 22, 24, 24, 25, 29, 30, 31, 35, 37, 37, 37, 46, 51, 54, 55, 61, 64
solution:
The correct answer is** 29.5**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** Median Calculation:

__
 
• Median is the middle value in a data set when arranged in ascending order.
 
• For a data set with an even number of observations, the median is the average of the two middle numbers.
 
• **With 24 observations, the median is the average of the 12th and 13th values.**
 
• In the given data set, the 12th value is 29 and the 13th value is 30.
 
• Therefore, the median is (29 + 30) / 2 = 29.5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 Let's analyze why the other options are incorrect:

 
• Option 1: 35.4 - This value is not the average of the 12th and 13th values in the sorted list.
 
• Option 2: 43.1 - This value is much higher than the average of the 12th and 13th values.
 
• Option 3: 31.3 - This value is slightly higher but does not match the correct median calculation.
 
• Option 4: 29.5 - This is the correct median as it is the average of the 12th and 13th values.

***Hence, the correct answer is 29.5.***
